reasoning: This is the standard UI glyph for an external link or 'open in new window/tab' (a square frame with an arrow pointing out of the top-right corner). While primarily interface chrome, it fits a narrow set of web development, content management, and digital admin tasks specifically about outbound links, redirects, or pop-out windows. At tiny sizes it can briefly resemble the 'compose/edit' icon (a square with a diagonal pencil in the top-right).

readings.meaning: external link / open in new window

pass1.ambiguity: Can be confused with maximize/fullscreen icons, iOS-style share icons, or compose/edit icons (square with a diagonal pencil) at very small sizes.
